title: lycopodium complanatum subsp. tristachyum
intro: Lycopodium complanatum subsp. tristachyum, commonly known as club moss, is a plant species belonging to the family Lycopodiaceae. The plant is valued for its traditional uses in herbal medicine, with reported health benefits including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Lycopodium complanatum subsp. tristachyum include expectorant and bronchodilator effects, which help in relieving congestion and improving breathing. The plant's bioactive constituents include alkaloids, such as trachealine and lycodine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
